meta.title: Release 3.4.0
meta.lede: Offline boarding passes, tide-aware cancellations, and the capacity fix from the 07:40, ready for the winter timetable. One required gate failed and two gates are pending. Ship or hold, then waive or rerun what did not pass.

parts.markdown: 3.4.0 carries what the winter timetable needs before it starts on 26 October. It reaches riders in stages: a tenth of app users on the first day, then everyone after three days without a rollback trigger.

parts.title: Changes
rows: Passes scan at the Brisk slipway with no signal.
A Brisk sailing too shallow for the ramp cancels early, with a notice.
The office approves each one for a month
Nothing, unless a deck is full, when a second sale is refused.
Fewer Gannet crossings and a later first boat to Keddle.

parts.title: Offline scan time on the oldest handheld, by build (ms)

items.title: Android end-to-end suite
items.summary: 212 of 214 scenarios passed, and both failures are offline scans on Android 10 handhelds.

facets.label: How checked
facets.markdown: CI job `e2e-android` on build 2291, across the four handheld models the crews carry.

facets.label: Result
facets.markdown: 212 of 214 passed. On Android 10, a scan made within 30 seconds of losing signal waits 4 seconds for the network before it checks offline.

facets.label: Evidence
facets.markdown: Job 18834, scenarios `offline-scan-signal-drop` and `offline-scan-airplane-mode`, with screen recordings attached.

facets.label: Risk
facets.markdown: Two of the Gannet's six handhelds run Android 10. Some scans at the Brisk ramp would take four seconds, and a queue of cars would notice.

items.title: App Store review
items.summary: Build 2291 went in for review on 29 September, and reviews have taken one to two days.

facets.label: How checked
facets.markdown: The build's status in App Store Connect.

facets.label: Result
facets.markdown: Waiting for review since 29 September at 16:20.

facets.label: Note
facets.markdown: Android does not wait on this, but staging one platform ahead of the other confuses the harbour office.

items.title: Harbour office walkthrough of tide cancellations
items.summary: The office has to agree to approve each automatic cancellation for the first month.

facets.label: How checked
facets.markdown: A walkthrough on the staging site with the harbour office, run by Ines.

facets.label: Result
facets.markdown: 1,904 passed and none failed. Twelve are skipped because they cover the retired summer Petrel timetable.

items.title: Load test at storm-day volume
items.summary: Six times normal traffic held booking at 420 ms p95, against an 800 ms target.

facets.label: How checked
facets.markdown: `k6 run load/storm-day.js` against staging for 30 minutes, at six times a normal winter Tuesday.

facets.label: Result
facets.markdown: 420 ms at p95 and 910 ms at p99, with no errors. The target is 800 ms at p95.

items.title: Accessibility pass on booking and passes
items.summary: Screen reader and keyboard checks passed on every changed screen, the new pass screen included.

facets.label: How checked
facets.markdown: VoiceOver and TalkBack walkthroughs by Mira, and `axe` in CI.

facets.label: Result
facets.markdown: Nothing blocking. The pass screen now reads out the sailing and party before the code.

items.title: Crash-free beta sessions above 99.5%
items.summary: The beta ran 99.62% crash-free over seven days and 1,840 sessions.

facets.label: How checked
facets.markdown: Crash reports from the 3.4.0 beta group, 22 to 29 September.

facets.label: Result
facets.markdown: 99.62% of 1,840 sessions were crash-free, above the 99.5% gate.

items.title: Wallet pass validation
items.summary: Not run, because wallet passes are out of scope for 3.4.0.

facets.label: Result
facets.markdown: Skipped by the offline boarding passes plan. Wallet passes wait for a later release.

parts.markdown: Roll back when crash-free sessions fall below 99% for an hour, or when more than 2 in 100 scans at any harbour fall back to the paper list. Joss or Tomas can do it alone, day or night.

parts.title: Rollback steps
parts.code:
# Stop the staged rollout where it is
release halt 3.4.0

# Turn offline passes off at Brisk; scanners go back to online checks
flags set offline-passes --harbour brisk --off

# Return the booking service to 3.3.2
deploy booking --version 3.3.2 --reason "rollback 3.4.0"
